minutes.headline: School Committee heard principals explain how bullying reports are investigated and why parents feel unheard; no votes taken.
minutes.summary: The committee discussed bullying with the superintendent, principals, an assistant principal, a social worker and special education staff. Administrators explained the legal definition versus "mean moments", investigation steps, confidentiality limits on disclosing discipline, and supports and prevention programs. The superintendent announced the SaferWatch anonymous reporting app and a plan to streamline the bullying plan; nothing was voted.

decisions.decision: Superintendent said the district will streamline the lengthy bullying plan over the summer while still meeting legal requirements.

District safety team selected the SaferWatch app for anonymous reporting; administrator training this summer, faculty early in the school year, then students; more information to the committee in the fall.
A principal said that next year the building will likely hold a separate parent meeting after open house on behavior and bullying procedures.

what_happened.line: The School Committee took no votes; it heard principals and staff explain how bullying reports are investigated and why some parents feel unheard.
The middle/high school principal described the investigation path, how the legal definition of bullying differs from conflict, and limits on disclosing discipline.
The district safety team selected the SaferWatch app for anonymous reporting, with administrator, faculty and then student training, and more information for the committee in the fall.
The superintendent said the lengthy bullying plan will be streamlined over the summer while still meeting legal requirements.

why_it_matters: Families who have reported bullying will see a new anonymous reporting tool and a shorter written bullying plan, which change how a report is made and what the district's procedure says.
Confidentiality rules limit what the district can tell a parent about discipline of another student, a mechanism that can leave families feeling nothing was done.

The streamlined bullying plan the superintendent said would be revised over the summer.
